floors.description: Object stack/intensity count. For houses it means floors; for non-house props/crops it is enhancement density from repeat taps. It must not be used to raise the ground.

terrainFloors.description: Ground height stack for the terrain layer only. Terrain repeat taps raise this value. Object repeat taps raise floors instead.

customName.description: Optional short name for a bespoke custom object authored via customParts.

customFootprint.description: Optional initial render footprint in tile units for customParts. Use about 1.1 for compact bridges/props, 1.2 for normal single-cell objects, and 1.5-1.8 only for deliberate hero objects.
